review_process.independence_limitations: Separate AI-agent contexts, both frozen before cross-review and candidate execution. Possible same-model-family correlated errors. No human, customer or authorized pilot validation.

method: Both original files preserved. Compare outcomes and semantic requirements/blockers/unknowns after independent SHA freeze; do not treat synonymous IDs or split-versus-combined requirement formatting as substantive disagreements. Each material scope, identity, completeness or blocker-denominator difference is listed below. All 36 comparisons are retained.
common_schema_normalization: Use first-review stable blocker IDs and evaluation-root-relative references; normalize mandatory requirement text to requirement. First review splits subject and coherent-identity checks; second groups subject conditions. Equivalent policy count, app binding and observations retain their raw references; naming/text differences are not separate disagreements. Public duplicate repository and organization review policies are combined by applicable strict conditions, never by summing approval counts.

first_review.finding: GitHub merge state is blocked while both same-name entries are required and one fails
Different Apps share the required unbound name; the exact cross-App selection semantics are not established by a producer identity-bearing GitHub result

second_review.finding: A required same-name ci / unit from app 222 failed while app 111 succeeded.

disagreements.resolution: Retain one generic GitHub merge-block finding and the exact cross-App resolution unknown. Do not count a second producer-specific failure.
disagreements.rationale: Both reviewers agree blocked/fail. Raw same-name flags lack producer IDs. A failing run and GitHub blocked are definite; a claim that this exact App independently supplies the mandatory blocker is less well established than the generic blockage.

Adjudication adopts the second reviewer conservative assurance scope; first reviewer explicitly accepted this scope choice. Collection/export availability remains a separate metric.

limits: Two AI-agent reviews are not human/customer validation. Same-family correlation remains possible.
Synthetic fixtures are authored scenarios rather than empirical repository outcomes. Public captures preserve observed incomplete authorization.
Unknown evidence remains unknown; procedural resolution is not a claim that every underlying policy or future state is known.
Scoped assurance choice in e20 is stricter than simple operational-policy satisfaction and is disclosed.
